import numpy as np


def compute_max_radii(centers):
    n = len(centers)
    r = np.minimum.reduce(
        (centers[:, 0], centers[:, 1], 1.0 - centers[:, 0], 1.0 - centers[:, 1])
    ).copy()
    for i in range(n):

            d = float(np.linalg.norm(centers[i] - centers[j]))

                scale = d / (r[i] + r[j])
                r[i] *= scale
                r[j] *= scale
    return np.maximum(r, 0.0)
